turns.user: I activated a 90-minute ticket at 14:00 and want to return by tram after my visit.
turns.agent:
The key detail is when you board the return tram. Your 90-minute mobile ticket’s window runs from 14:00 to 15:30. It allows transfers on covered lines within that window; if you make your final transfer before 15:30, you may finish that last ride after 15:30. Validate at the start of a ride and when changing lines (except between metro lines).

So, if you board the return tram before 15:30, the ticket can cover it, assuming the route is within the applicable area and you follow the mobile-ticket validation steps. If you board after 15:30, it won’t cover the new tram ride. It requires an internet-connected phone and has no paper equivalent. This is based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check.

See BKK’s 90-minute ticket page for current terms. What time do you expect to board the tram back?

turns.user: The return tram boards at 15:29 and I get off at 15:52. Is that valid?
turns.agent:
Yes—according to the 5 November 2026 snapshot, that ride is covered if 15:29 is when you board the tram, it’s on a covered line, and you use the mobile ticket as required. Your 90-minute window ends at 15:30; the rule allows you to finish the last ride after the window when you boarded it within the window. Getting off at 15:52 is therefore okay under that rule.

BKK’s 90-minute ticket page is the official reference for current terms; I haven’t live-checked it.
